title: Structural and functional characterization of NEMO cleavage by SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro
authors: Hameedi MA; Prates ET; Garvin MR; Mathews I; Kirtley Amos B; Demerdash O; Bechthold M; Iyer M; Rahighi S; Kneller DW; Kovalevsky A; Irle S; Vuong V; Mitchell JC; Labbe A; Galanie S; Wakatsuki S; Jacobson D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构和计算预测研究SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro对宿主蛋白NEMO的切割机制，属于蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，但机器学习与物理计算方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测，故给予中档评分。
abstract: In addition to its essential role in viral polyprotein processing, the SARS-CoV-2 3C-like (3CLpro) protease can cleave human immune signaling proteins, like NF-κB Essential Modulator (NEMO) and deregulate the host immune response. Here, in vitro assays show that SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro cleaves NEMO with fine-tuned efficiency. Analysis of the 2.14 Å resolution crystal structure of 3CLpro C145S bound to NEMO 226-235 reveals subsites that tolerate a range of viral and host substrates through main chain hydrogen bonds while also enforcing specificity using side chain hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic contacts. Machine learning- and physics-based computational methods predict that variation in key binding residues of 3CLpro- NEMO helps explain the high fitness of SARS-CoV-2 in humans. We posit that cleavage of NEMO is an important piece of information to be accounted for in the pathology of COVID-19.
abstract_zh: 除了在病毒多聚蛋白加工中的关键作用外，SARS-CoV-2 3C样蛋白酶（3CLpro）还能切割人类免疫信号蛋白，如NF-κB必需调节因子（NEMO），并失调宿主免疫反应。在此，体外实验表明，SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro以精细调节的效率切割NEMO。对3CLpro C145S与NEMO 226-235结合复合物的2.14 Å分辨率晶体结构分析揭示，亚位点通过主链氢键容忍多种病毒和宿主底物，同时利用侧链氢键和疏水接触执行特异性。基于机器学习和物理学的计算方法预测，3CLpro-NEMO关键结合残基的变异有助于解释SARS-CoV-2在人类中的高适应性。我们认为，NEMO的切割是COVID-19病理学中需要考虑的重要信息。
